arxiv-1809-02951.title: The Laurent Extension of Quantum Plane: a Complete List of 𝑼 𝒒 ​ ( 𝖘 ​ 𝖑 𝟐 ) \boldsymbol{U_{q}(\mathfrak{sl}_{2})} -Symmetries
arxiv-1809-02951.creator: Sergey SINEL’SHCHIKOV
arxiv-1809-02951.description: Abstract This work finishes a classification of U q ​ ( 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 2 ) U_{q}(\mathfrak{sl}_{2}) -symmetries on the Laurent extension ℂ q ​ [ x ± 1 , y ± 1 ] \mathbb{C}_{q}\big[x^{\pm 1},y^{\pm 1}\big] of the quantum plane.

arxiv-2105-04575.title: On the absence of backsplash analogues to NGC 3109 in the Λ \Lambda CDM framework 2021 On the absence of backsplash analogues to NGC 3109 in the Λ \Lambda CDM framework – References
arxiv-2105-04575.creator: Indranil Banik, Moritz Haslbauer, Marcel S. Pawlowski, Benoit Famaey & Pavel Kroupa
arxiv-2105-04575.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Indranil Banik, Moritz Haslbauer, Marcel S. Pawlowski, Benoit Famaey & Pavel Kroupa. The dwarf galaxy NGC 3109 is receding 105 km/s faster than expected in a Λ \Lambda CDM timing argument analysis of the Local Group and external galaxy groups within 8 Mpc (Banik & Zhao 2018).

arxiv-2209-03065.title: Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity and near-extremal BTZ thermodynamics
arxiv-2209-03065.creator: Rohan R. Poojary a
arxiv-2209-03065.description: Abstract We study the near horizon 2d gravity theory which captures the near extremal thermodynamics of BTZ with excess mass δ ​ M \delta M and excess angular momentum δ ​ J = ℒ ​ δ ​ M \delta J=\mathcal{L}\,\delta M over extremality.

arxiv-2402-05039.title: PAC Learnability under Explanation-Preserving Graph Perturbations
arxiv-2402-05039.creator: Xu Zheng, Farhad Shirani, Tianchun Wang, Shouwei Gao, Wenqian Dong, Wei Cheng, Dongsheng Luo
arxiv-2402-05039.description: Abstract Graphical models capture relations between entities in a wide range of applications including social networks, biology, and natural language processing, among others. Graph neural networks (GNN) are neural models that operate over graphs, enabling the model to leverage the complex relationships and dependencies in graph-structured data.

arxiv-2403-15879.title: TrustSQL: Benchmarking Text-to-SQL Reliability with Penalty-Based Scoring
arxiv-2403-15879.creator: Gyubok Lee, Woosog Chay, Seonhee Cho, Edward Choi
arxiv-2403-15879.description: Abstract Text-to-SQL enables users to interact with databases using natural language, simplifying the retrieval and synthesis of information. Despite the remarkable success of large language models (LLMs) in translating natural language questions into SQL queries, widespread deployment remains limited due to two primary challenges.

arxiv-2403-20123.title: Shadoks Approach to Knapsack Polygonal Packing
arxiv-2403-20123.creator: Guilherme D. da Fonseca, Yan Gerard
arxiv-2403-20123.description: Abstract The 2024 edition of the CG:SHOP Challenge focused on the knapsack polygonal packing problem. Each instance consists of a convex polygon known as the container and a multiset of items , where each item is a simple polygon with an associated integer value .

arxiv-2405-15741.title: Near-threshold states in coupled D ​ D ∗ − D ∗ ​ D ∗ DD^{\ast}-D^{\ast}D^{\ast} scattering from lattice QCD
arxiv-2405-15741.creator: Travis Whyte, David J. Wilson, Christopher E. Thomas, for the Hadron Spectrum Collaboration
arxiv-2405-15741.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Travis Whyte, David J. Wilson, Christopher E. Thomas, for the Hadron Spectrum Collaboration. The first determination of doubly-charmed isospin-0 coupled-channel D ​ D ∗ − D ∗ ​ D ∗ DD^{\ast}-D^{\ast}D^{\ast} scattering amplitudes from lattice QCD is presented. The finite-volume spectrum is computed for three lattice volumes with a light-quark mass corresponding to m π ≈ 391 m_{\pi}\approx 391 MeV and is used to extract the scattering amplitudes in J P = 1 + J^{P}=1^{+} via the Lüscher quantization condition.

europmc-pmc5918521.creator: Gallo F, Fossi C, Weber R, Santillo D, Sousa J, Ingram I, Nadal A, Romano D.
europmc-pmc5918521.description: Persistent plastics, with an estimated lifetime for degradation of hundreds of years in marine conditions, can break up into micro- and nanoplastics over shorter timescales, thus facilitating their uptake by marine biota throughout the food chain. These polymers may contain...

plos-pone-0344934.title: Regional trends and forecasting of under-five child mortality in Bangladesh: A mixed method approach of Functional ANOVA and Bayesian spatiotemporal modeling
plos-pone-0344934.creator: Md Ismail Hossain, M Sheikh Giash Uddin, Azizur Rahman, Shuvongkar Sarkar
plos-pone-0344934.description: Regional trends and forecasting of under-five child mortality in Bangladesh: A mixed method approach of Functional ANOVA and Bayesian spatiotemporal modeling

pmc-10675142.title: Driving Environment Inference from POI of Navigation Map: Fuzzy Logic and Machine Learning Approaches
pmc-10675142.creator: Yu Li, Martin Metzner, Volker Schwieger, Arturo de la Escalera Hueso
pmc-10675142.description: To adapt vehicle control and plan strategies in a predictive manner, it is usually desired to know the context of a driving environment. This paper aims at efficiently inferring the following five driving environments around vehicle’s vicinity: shopping zone, tourist zone, public station, motor service area, and security zone, whose existences are not necessarily mutually exclusive.

pmc-11526124.title: Research trends in nutritional interventions for stroke: a bibliometric analysis and literature review
pmc-11526124.creator: Yipeng Xie, Yuan Xiong, Mengyue Sun, Yan Zhao, Miao Wu
pmc-11526124.description: BackgroundOver the past 23 years, there has been a thorough analysis of literature concerning nutritional interventions, nutrients, and feeding approaches related to stroke. Furthermore, a scientific knowledge map was established, elucidating the current state of research, examining its development and trends, and offering new research viewpoints for the future.

pmc-11579612.title: Contextual factors impacting WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control implementation in Africa—a scoping review
pmc-11579612.creator: Shashika Bandara, Masauso Moses Phiri, Peter Magati, Jeffrey Drope, Alayne Adams, Matthew Hunt, Raphael Lencucha
pmc-11579612.description: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), tobacco use causes over 8 million deaths annually including 1.3 million due to second-hand exposure. Furthermore, data from the Tobacco Atlas show that the tobacco industry continues to target new markets in the WHO African region, one of two regions where absolute numbers of smokers continue to increase.

pmc-11713827.title: Preclinical Dementia Risk Estimation: Attitudes and Views of Relatives of Dementia Patients – The PreTAD‐Study
pmc-11713827.creator: Michelle Gerards, Annika Baumeister, Constanze Hübner, Federica Ribaldi, Yahveth Cantero‐Fortiz, Julia Braun, Mercè Boada, Giovanni B Frisoni, Björn Schmitz‐Luhn, Carolin Schwegler, Christiane Woopen, Frank Jessen, Ayda Rostamzadeh
pmc-11713827.description: BackgroundDue to further development of diagnostic methods of early‐stage diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and new disease‐modifying treatment options that require early diagnosis, a new focus on predictive and preventive medicine arises. With progress in AD dementia risk estimation, guidelines for counseling, considering individual aspects of those affected, are becoming more important.

pmc-12580219.title: Clinical Application of 3D‐Printed Custom Hemipelvic Prostheses With Re‐Entrant Chiral Structure in Reconstruction After Pelvic Tumor Resection
pmc-12580219.creator: Linyun Tan, Ye Li, Xin Hu, Yitian Wang, Xiaolu Zhang, Xiaoyan Liu, Yi Luo, Yong Zhou, Chongqi Tu, Xiao Yang, Li Min
pmc-12580219.description: ObjectivesPelvic reconstruction with conventional 3D‐printed prostheses faces a critical trade‐off, where achieving sufficient porosity for optimal bone ingrowth often compromises essential mechanical stability. To address this challenge, this study evaluates the clinical outcomes of 3D‐printed hemipelvic prostheses incorporating re‐entrant chiral structure (RCS), a novel negative Poisson's ratio design, in patients undergoing pelvic reconstruction following tumor resection.

pmc-13178929.title: Analyses of eye lens stable isotopes across ontogeny of trophically diverse freshwater salmonids
pmc-13178929.creator: Glenn T Schumacher, Ernst B Peebles, Nathan B Furey, Michael T Kinnison, Gregory R Kronisch, Christina A Murphy, Arnar Palsson
pmc-13178929.description: Ontogenetic niche shifts in fishes are nearly universal but remain poorly understood in many species despite being fundamentally important for the persistence, management, and conservation of fish populations, including those of vulnerable salmonids. Eye lens stable isotope analysis has proven useful in studying ontogeny in some marine species but has rarely been applied in freshwater fishes.

pmc-13258643.title: Deep Learning-Guided Reverse Translation Enhances Soluble Expression of Recombinant Proteins in Escherichia coli
pmc-13258643.creator: Dong Yu, Nan Geng, Lin Fan, Yanmei Qin, Shangshang Sun, Hao Chen, Ruoyu Wang, Xiaoping Liao, Chun You
pmc-13258643.description: Enhancing the soluble expression of heterologous proteins in chassis microorganisms is critical for fundamental biological research and synthetic biology-driven industrial applications. Current methods for designing DNA sequences to ensure high soluble expression often rely excessively on high-frequency codons while overlooking optimal codon context, leading to suboptimal outcomes.

pmc-13388249.title: A prediction model for platinum-resistant recurrence of ovarian cancer was established using multimodal artificial intelligence machine learning methods
pmc-13388249.creator: Xuanxuan Zhao, Ling Ma, Peiquan Li, Zhijun Hu, Yue Ding, Qing Liu, Kaijiang Liu
pmc-13388249.description: AimTo develop and validate a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI)-based prediction model for platinum-resistant recurrence in ovarian cancer by integrating clinical data, medical imaging, and medical knowledge resources, with the goal of improving early risk stratification and supporting individualized treatment decisions.

pmc-13406646.title: Navigating the Algorithm: A Narrative Review of Social Media’s Impact on Mental Health in Clinical and Non-Clinical Adolescent Populations
pmc-13406646.creator: Andreea Socol, Lucia Emanuela Andrei, Catrinel Maria Dijmarescu, Diana Dragomir, Alexandra-Diana Iotu, Ilinca Mihailescu, Florina Rad
pmc-13406646.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: In recent years, there has been a growing concern regarding social media driving the decline of mental health, especially among adolescents. However, scientific consensus remains mixed, with many studies reporting only small or inconsistent associations. Aims: This paper aims to present the latest and most influential findings in the field of social media, with a focus on understanding the impact it has on adolescents’ mental health by looking at clinical versus non-clinical populations.

pmc-13439455.title: Potential utility of postmortem CT-based classification as a practical pre-autopsy assessment tool for hepatic steatosis
pmc-13439455.creator: Ji-Hwan Park, Ji Su Han, Hyeong-Geon Kim, Jong-In Na
pmc-13439455.description: This study aimed to establish postmortem computed tomography (PMCT)-specific Hounsfield unit (HU) criteria and developed an HU-based assessment tool for pre-autopsy triage of hepatic steatosis. Overall, 166 deceased individuals underwent whole-body PMCT followed by autopsy with liver histopathology. Hepatic attenuation was measured as a volumetric mean HU of the entire liver and as a four-point mean HU.

pmc-13669023.title: Not that cloze: Sentence constraint is influenced by language and language dominance
pmc-13669023.creator: Ana Bautista, Clara D Martin
pmc-13669023.description: In the fields of language processing and prediction, cloze tests are used to establish sentence constraint norms. The validity of cloze test results depends heavily on how closely the pre-test population matches the main study population, and yet there is limited evidence on how sociolinguistic variables may influence sentence constraint.
